project.name: tmux-rendez-vous
project.description: A Tmux TPM plugin to manage tmux sessions — pick, connect, save, restore, and link windows across sessions with a unified interface.

nodes.name: .harper-dictionary.txt
nodes.summary: Harper linter custom dictionary. Contains allowed words and linting rule codes (CPY001, D100, D101, D103, RUF027, S603, S607, T201) plus project-specific terms (SubprocessError, TPM, keybinding, keybindings, noqa).

nodes.name: .pre-commit-config.yaml
nodes.summary: Pre-commit hooks configuration. Enforces conventional commits (v4.4.0), general file hygiene (trailing whitespace, end-of-file fixer, large file checks, symlink checks, private key detection, mixed line endings), YAML/JSON/XML/TOML validation (excluding tests), and bash shell linting (shell-lint with JSON output).

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent guidelines for AI assistants working on tmux-rendez-vous. Documents project overview (Tmux TPM plugin in bash), external dependencies (sesh, lazy-tmux, fzf), build/lint/test commands (pre-commit, manual tmux testing), architecture (plugin.tmux entry point, bin/ scripts), tmux conventions, and Understand-Anything knowledge graph commands.

nodes.name: CHANGELOG.md
nodes.summary: Project changelog tracking notable changes across releases. Documents v0.1.0 (2026-04-22) with session management features (daemon, linker, mutex, notify, picker, save/restore/switch/close/list) and v0.2.0 (2026-07-13) with bug fixes, hooks support, linked windows, and tmux-bash-lib integration. Generated by cocogitto.

nodes.name: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
nodes.summary: Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct v2.1. Defines community standards, acceptable/unacceptable behavior, enforcement responsibilities, and graduated consequences (correction, warning, temporary ban, permanent ban). Contact: gilles@ideographe.fr.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Contribution guidelines. Covers development workflow (fork, branch, edit), PR guidelines (fixup commits, rebase squash), and style reference (Google Python Style Guide). Notes changelog is maintained by maintainers.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Main project documentation for tmux-rendez-vous. Describes the TPM plugin that unifies sesh (session management) and lazy-tmux (session persistence) behind a tmux popup picker. Documents features: rendez-vous picker (4 sources: tmux sessions, sleeping sessions, config sessions, zoxide dirs), save daemon with hooks, notification system, window-linker, command aliases, and full tmux option configuration table. Lists requirements (tmux 3.6+, bash 4.4+, tmux-bash-lib, sesh, lazy-tmux, fzf, zoxide).

nodes.name: cog.toml
nodes.summary: Cocogitto configuration for conventional commits and changelog generation. Defines commit types (fix, security, perf, refactor, docs for changelog; chore, ci, style, test omitted). Generates CHANGELOG.md from git history with author gravures/Gilles Coissac. Tag prefix 'v', skip_ci enabled, ignore merge commits.

nodes.name: pyrightconfig.json
nodes.summary: Pyright type-checker configuration for Python 3.11 across all platforms. Includes execution environments for ./lib, ./tests, and ./.venv. Most type-checking rules are disabled (reportAny: false, individual rules set to false for .venv). Ignores ./typings and ./.venv directories.

nodes.name: ruff.toml
nodes.summary: Ruff linter and formatter configuration. Line length 99, src directories (tests, libs, .). Selects ALL rules with specific ignores (annotations, pandas, trailing commas, docstrings, subprocess, todo format, etc.). Per-file ignores for tests (print, docstrings, type annotations, assertions) and .pyi files. Configures isort (Google-style with future annotations), pydocstyle (Google convention), pylint (magic value types), and McCabe complexity (max 12).

nodes.name: rumdl.toml
nodes.summary: rumdl markdown linter configuration. Line length 100, disables MD033 (inline HTML) and MD064 (repeated header style) rules.

nodes.name: config.json
nodes.summary: OpenCode analysis configuration specifying output language as English.

nodes.name: fingerprints.json
nodes.summary: Content fingerprints (SHA-256 hashes) and structural analysis metadata for all 19 project source files. Tracks file versions, line counts, functions, classes, imports, and exports to enable incremental re-analysis.

nodes.name: knowledge-graph.json
nodes.summary: Full knowledge graph of tmux-rendez-vous containing 70 nodes across 6 layers (Plugin Entry, Core Scripts, Configuration, Documentation, Analysis Output, Analysis Tooling), 72 edges with typed relationships, and a 7-step guided tour of the architecture.

nodes.name: meta.json
nodes.summary: Analysis metadata: last analyzed 2026-08-02, git commit 999ce9f, version 1.0.0, 39 files analyzed.

nodes.name: plugin.tmux
nodes.summary: TPM plugin entry point. Sources tmux::plugin.sh, validates tmux 3.6+/bash 4.4+/sesh/lazy-tmux/fzf, sets default options, defines command aliases, and conditionally starts rdv-saver-daemon.

nodes.name: rendez-vous
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper that opens a tmux popup (80%×70%) running rendez-vous-picker for session selection.

nodes.name: rendez-vous-picker
nodes.summary: Interactive fzf-based session picker. Lists sessions via list-rendez-vous, connects via connect-rendez-vous, closes via close-rendez-vous, kills with _fzf-modal confirmation, and previews with sesh preview.

nodes.name: connect-rendez-vous
nodes.summary: Connects to or restores a tmux session. Checks sleeping sessions via list-rendez-vous, acquires mutex lock, runs before/after hooks via rdv-notify, handles linked windows via verify-linked-windows, and optionally connects via sesh.

nodes.name: close-rendez-vous
nodes.summary: Closes a tmux session. If active, saves via save-rendez-vous then kills the session. If sleeping, removes from lazy-tmux persistence via lazy-tmux forget.

nodes.name: save-rendez-vous
nodes.summary: Saves tmux session state. Acquires mutex, runs before/after hooks via rdv-notify, calls lazy-tmux save (single or all sessions), saves linked windows via verify-linked-windows, supports scrollback option.

nodes.name: list-rendez-vous
nodes.summary: Lists available sessions from multiple sources: active tmux sessions (sesh --tmux), sleeping sessions (lazy-tmux list), configs (sesh --config), and zoxide directories (sesh --zoxide). Supports filter flags and icon mode.

nodes.name: rdv-notify
nodes.summary: Notification daemon and task handler. Daemon mode: manages a spinner, tracks task status (pending/done/failed), updates tmux status bar. Task handler mode: launches a command, reports status to daemon pipe. Uses mutex for singleton daemon.

nodes.name: rdv-saver-daemon
nodes.summary: Periodic save daemon. Sleeps for configurable interval (from @rendez-vous-save-daemon-interval), then runs save-rendez-vous. Uses mutex for singleton enforcement.

nodes.name: _fzf-modal
nodes.summary: Terminal UI modal dialog for confirmations. Manages raw terminal mode, cursor positioning, box drawing with word-wrapping, and y/N input handling. Used by rendez-vous-picker for kill confirmation.

nodes.name: verify-linked-windows
nodes.summary: Python script for managing tmux window linking across sessions. Save mode: records linked window sources in lazy-tmux JSON files. Restore mode: relinks windows, loading source sessions via connect-rendez-vous if needed.

nodes.name: window-linker
nodes.summary: Displays a tmux menu listing unlinked windows from other sessions that can be linked into the current session. Supports pagination and customizable colors.

nodes.name: changelog.tera
nodes.summary: Tera template for generating changelogs from git-commitguru data. Handles version tags, package updates, and scoped/unscoped commit grouping.

nodes.name: popup-with-scratch-session.md
nodes.summary: Documentation snippet showing how to launch rendez-vous-picker inside a tmux popup via a temporary scratch session.

nodes.name: .shellcheckrc
nodes.summary: ShellCheck configuration enabling external sources and setting source path to tmux-bash-lib/lib.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Understand-Anything ignore patterns file. Lists commented-out exclusion patterns for various languages (Python, JS, Go, Rust, etc.).

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand tmux-rendez-vous: a TPM plugin that unifies sesh (session management) and lazy-tmux (persistence) behind a tmux popup picker.

tour.title: Plugin Entry Point
tour.description: plugin.tmux bootstraps the plugin: sources tmux-bash-lib, validates dependencies (tmux 3.6+, bash 4.4+, sesh, lazy-tmux, fzf), sets default options, and conditionally starts the save daemon.

tour.title: The Picker Flow
tour.description: rendez-vous is a thin wrapper that opens a tmux popup running rendez-vous-picker — the interactive fzf-based session browser that aggregates 4 sources (active sessions, sleeping sessions, configs, zoxide dirs).

tour.title: Session Lifecycle
tour.description: connect-rendez-vous handles session restoration with mutex locking, hooks, and linked windows. close-rendez-vous saves then kills sessions. list-rendez-vous queries all session sources via sesh and lazy-tmux.

tour.title: Persistence & Save Daemon
tour.description: save-rendez-vous persists session state via lazy-tmux with before/after hooks. rdv-saver-daemon runs periodic saves in the background using a configurable interval.

tour.title: Window Linking & Notifications
tour.description: verify-linked-windows (Python) manages cross-session window linking. window-linker displays a menu of linkable windows. rdv-notify provides a daemon+task notification system using a named pipe and tmux status bar.

tour.title: Configuration & Tooling
tour.description: Project tooling: pre-commit hooks for conventional commits and linting, cocogitto for changelog generation, ruff/pyright/rumdl for Python and markdown linting, and shellcheck for bash validation.
